$comment: The libraries the macOS apps link and package-macos.sh bundles, built for the triplets in ./triplets (MacOS/deps/README.md).
name: ultracanvas-macos-deps

dependencies.$comment: libvips' HEIF / AVIF codec: HEIC decoding through libde265 (LGPL), AVIF decoding and encoding through aom (BSD). Not its default hevc feature: that is x265, GPL-2.0, which libvips - and so every app linking the core - would carry. Without it the Mac apps read HEIC but do not write it.
dependencies.name: libheif

dependencies.$comment: The formats Homebrew's vips linked in (its loadable modules never reached the bundles), less cgif, libimagequant and libultrahdr, which vcpkg does not have; the apps write GIF themselves when gifsave is missing.
dependencies.name: libvips
